# Upstream

The `*.py` files and `data/*.txt` are byte-identical copies of `src/dizione/`
of https://github.com/n4ze3m/dizione at commit
`8cd889e4de7be6bd1dd2e6891344a0729fa14dd4`. `LICENSE` is the licence file of
the same commit (Apache-2.0).

dizione's `identity()` hashes every `*.py` file in this directory, so this
note is not a Python file, and no other Python file goes here.
